title: Direct derivation of the modified Langevin noise formalism from the canonical quantization of macroscopic electromagnetism
summary: The modified Langevin noise formalism (MLNF) models the interaction of the quantized electromagnetic field with an arbitrary lossy magneto-dielectric object placed in vacuum using three types of non-interacting bosonic polaritons: scattering, electric, and magnetic. These respectively represent free-space photons scattered by the object, and photons radiated by quantized electric and magnetic dipolar sources embedded within its volume. Recently [A. Ciattoni, Phys. Rev. A 110, 013707 (2024)], this formalism was justified from the canonical quantization of macroscopic electromagnetism (CQME)…
